en: The image shows a black and white photograph of a rural church building with a prominent tower and a pitched roof. The church is partly obscured by trees and is set behind a traditional wooden fence, next to a dirt road. The setting appears rustic and peaceful, characteristic of the northern countryside. The text 'ERÄJÄRVEN KIRKKO.' is printed in the upper left corner of the postcard.
